purpose: Sequential broad equal-step prior factor tuning of the frozen 30-calendar-day Smart-1 version, using only information and outcomes through 2024-12-31.

execution.fees_slippage_and_corporate_actions: same as batch_003; final champion requires raw-price and corporate-action audit

component_construction.cross_sectional_ranks: causal same-day ranks using only values known by that close, identical to batch_003
component_construction.M: direct nonnegative weighted sum of the three frozen models' raw predictions, followed by same-day cross-sectional percentile rank minus 0.5
component_construction.T: nonnegative weighted sum of four directed same-day ranks: +mom120, +(close/high60-1), +mom20, and -vol60; then same-day cross-sectional percentile rank minus 0.5
component_construction.H: nonnegative weighted sum of four directed same-day ranks: -size proxy, -vol60, +overnight20, and -intraday20; then causal per-symbol rolling 5-session mean with min_periods=3, followed by same-day cross-sectional percentile rank minus 0.5
component_construction.signal_selection: rank outer score descending within each date, stable symbol-ascending tie break, take inherited batch_003 30cal daily_top_k subject to maximum 3

sequential_phases.name: M_internal_weights
sequential_phases.inherit: batch_003 30cal T and H internal formulas, outer M/T/H weights, and daily_top_k

sequential_phases.name: T_internal_weights
sequential_phases.inherit: phase 1 unique winner plus batch_003 30cal H internal formula, outer M/T/H weights, and daily_top_k

sequential_phases.name: H_internal_weights
sequential_phases.inherit: phase 1 and phase 2 unique winners plus batch_003 30cal outer M/T/H weights and daily_top_k

sequential_phases.name: outer_M_T_H_weights
sequential_phases.inherit: all three internal unique winners and batch_003 30cal daily_top_k

reporting.development_note: 2022-2024 is development data, not a holdout or blind test
